description: Generic <BatchToolRunner> component. Promotes the previous one-tool ReportCommentsBatch into a reusable CSV-driven batch generator. Any AIToolPage tool can opt in by passing batchable={true}; AIToolPage automatically infers a BatchToolSpec from the tool's field list. End-of-term Pupil Passport season for a SENCO with 200 children turns from a two-day slog into a 20-minute coffee break.
steps: Create client/src/components/BatchToolRunner.tsx with a column-agnostic CSV parser, sequential-with-progress generation loop, abort button, and Copy-All / Download exports.
Expose BatchToolSpec interface with toolSlug, title, columns, buildPrompt, optional templateCsv and maxRows.
Add batchable?: boolean and batchSpec?: Partial<BatchToolSpec> props to AIToolPage.
When batchable && children.length > 0, render a Single | Batch (whole class) toggle above the form.
When Batch mode is active, render <BatchToolRunner> instead of the form. Default batchSpec is inferred from the tool's field list.
Opt SmartTargets and PupilPassport into batchable={true}.
acceptance_criteria: Tools opting in show a Batch tab when at least one pupil is registered.
Pasting/uploading a CSV with the inferred columns generates outputs sequentially with a progress bar.
Existing ReportComments single/batch toggle continues to work — the legacy ReportCommentsBatch component is unchanged for backward compatibility.
Stop button cancels the in-flight batch.
verification: Manual: SmartTargets → Batch → Load Template → edit two rows → Generate All.
findings: Existing ReportCommentsBatch was left untouched to avoid behaviour regression for the report-comments flow. The new generic runner is a strict superset and could replace it in a follow-up.
